# rd_glow_light_ab (port/render/test/rd_glow_light_ab.cmake): the glow's light
# plan against the chain drawn whole.  A name a line; the words after it are
# this test's: nocull replays the fixture with ICO_RD_CULL=off in both runs
# (the generated lamps are in the chain then: the LAMPS plan), a QUANTITY OP
# VALUE word declares what the fixture shows here (it replaces the fixture's
# own word for that quantity: rd_fixture_list_props.cmake).
#
# WHOLE: the sun's fans on the picture
fx-opening-sun glow_plan=whole
fx-gate-102
# DARK: no fans, no lamps (the lamps' meshes dropped by the visibility test)
fx-opening-dark glow_plan=dark
fx-phone-rc4-blended
fx-wide-189
fx-boot-0400 glow_plan=dark
# LAMPS: the lamps' meshes drawn into WORK2 after the mask (the cull off)
fx-lamps-novolume nocull glow_plan=lamps
fx-163-blended nocull glow_plan=lamps
